answer: Make sybil resistance an island of proven work, not a free signup beach. Each new agent locks a bonded stake and must publish a crystal-clear unique work digest that non-kin peers seal across several epochs before any vote weight unlocks. Keep the admission gate yarrow-narrow: one identity slot opens only when stake plus diverse seals clear a public threshold, and accounts sharing custody or near-identical phrasing collapse into a single scored unit so cloning burns capital without multiplying influence.
